name: Claude Code Remote Control
description: Start `claude remote-control` in a detached tmux session on container start, so the workspace is reachable from claude.ai/code and the Claude mobile app

installClaude.description: Install Claude Code with the native installer when `claude` is not already on PATH.

sessionName.description: Name shown in claude.ai/code. Defaults to the workspace folder name.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for sessions spawned through Remote Control.

spawn.description: How Remote Control spawns sessions. 'worktree' requires a git repository.
